column1: # quiet-mac daemon policy. Tab-separated: action, domain, label, why.
# action: freeze (SIGSTOP; launchd does not respawn a job that has not exited),
#         term (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL; the memory is released),
#         flag (launchctl disable only; a kill comes back within about a second).
# domain: gui or user (this user), system (root helper; never frozen).
# freeze+system is rejected: a stopped root process stalls shutdown, and the
# thaw agent only sees this user's processes.
# tests/test_quiet_mac.py checks this file against macos/sip-doit-with-sudo.sh,

column4: Proactive suggestions; long-lived, respawns if killed
iCloud sync for this user; long-lived
Shortcuts and App Intents; long-lived, respawns if killed
Visual Look Up, Live Text, Photos object search
Screen Time usage feed; SIGSTOP is EPERM (2026-11-15), so a freeze never lands
In-app Help Viewer content; short one-shot
Siri voices for Spoken Content; idle-exits
Writing Tools runtime; clients respawn it immediately
Apple Intelligence context; clients respawn it immediately
Left running: a freeze hangs clients such as sudo's password sheet
Contacts store; lives in the user domain, not gui
On-device model manager; coreaudiod respawns it immediately
Model catalog; coreaudiod respawns it immediately
Audio analytics; coreaudiod would respawn a kill
